subject: Trial ramp checkpoint and action tether
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@velosite.com>, Caroline Li <caroline@velosite.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial ramp checkpoint and action tether

Hi Samir / Caroline — thanks for carving out time today. Quick recap and a compact set of next steps so we keep momentum for the 3-week trial window we discussed.

Recap (30m call):
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for real-time ticket summarization + intent routing for Velosite support queues (volume: ~4-6k tickets/mo).
- Success criteria we sketched: 85% accurate intent classification (eval set), average latency <= 120ms per message at 20 TPS, and reproducible end-to-end results on a 1-week sample.
- Data access: you confirmed an SFTP feed + a sample CSV extract.

Agreed next steps (owners & times):
1) Data handoff — Velosite to drop 7-day sample + schema to the SFTP folder and share credentials (owner: Samir) — target Tue 10/27 EOD.
2) Redwood setup — we will provision a private trial namespace, load sample data, and run baseline inference with our small-sample profile (owner: Tessa) — target Wed 10/28.
3) Evaluation plan — agree on an eval set (500 labelled examples) and baseline metrics (owner: Monica) — target Fri 10/30.
4) Weekly checkpoint — 30m sync every Friday during the trial window (owner: Ben to calendar) — first meeting 10/30.

Attachments: redwood-poc-setup-guide.pdf (setup checklist), velosite-data-map.xlsx (sample schema template).

Can you confirm the timeline above and whether any procurement or security approvals need to be queued now? If Samir can share SFTP creds by Tue morning we'll get the provisioning started that afternoon.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Trial ramp checkpoint and action tether

Tessa — thanks for the tidy recap. Confirming a few items and a small ask:

1) Data handoff: we uploaded a 7-day sample to SFTP (path: sftp.velosite.com/incoming/poc_sample_oct25). Credentials attached as a text file in the secure channel (I'll email IT copy to Ben & Monica separately).
2) Security: basic IP allow-listing is required from our security team; I'll open the ticket today (ETA 48 hours).
3) Procurement: no PO needed for the trial; we may need a standard NDA addendum — legal will ping if so.

A couple clarifications on success criteria from our side:
- For intent classification, we care most about top-2 recall for the triage categories (billing, technical, account changes).
- Latency target we set is on p95, not average (can you confirm Redwood can report p95)?

I've attached the data map we promised (velosite-data-map.xlsx) and an internal contact who will share the labeled examples if needed: Caroline Li (caroline@velosite.com).

Samir

Subject: Re: Trial ramp checkpoint and action tether

Thanks Samir — great, I see the SFTP path. Two quick confirmations and an ask for owners below.

Confirmations:
- We can report p95 latency and will measure at the 20 TPS simulation you described. We'll add p95 to the dashboard.
- IP allow-listing: we'll share the Redwood egress IPs and a short firewall doc by EOD today so your SecOps can finish the ticket.

Owners & micro-tasks (adding a bit more granularity so nothing stalls):
A) Velosite (Samir / Caroline)
  - Share SFTP creds and confirm retention policy for the sample (Samir) — due Tue 10/27 (noted done).
  - Provide a seed set of 150 labelled tickets across the three triage categories to bootstrap eval tooling (Caroline) — target Thu 10/29 EOD.

B) Redwood (Tessa / Monica / Ben)
  - Provision private trial namespace + baseline model profile and run ingestion pipeline (Tessa) — Wed 10/28.
  - Setup eval harness and label tracking, push initial metrics to the shared dashboard (Monica) — Fri 10/30.
  - Schedule the weekly 30m checkpoint and invite Velosite stakeholders (Ben) — first meeting Fri 10/30 10:00am PT.

Temporary acceptance criteria (we'll refine once the seed labels arrive):
- Top-2 recall >= 0.88 across triage categories on the seed set.
- p95 inference latency <= 120ms at the 20 TPS replay.
- Integration: sample messages route correctly to downstream queue (manual verification).

Attachments: redwood-poc-setup-guide.pdf (contains firewall egress IPs + provisioning steps).

If all good I'll proceed with provisioning this afternoon. Caroline — can you confirm who on your team will own the 150 labelled tickets? If you prefer, we can share a quick labeling template to speed that up.

Cheers,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Looping in with a short status nudge as we hit the first week boundary:

Internal status (Redwood):
- Namespace provisioned and baseline model run (Tessa): ingest completed, no schema blockers.
- Eval harness in progress (Monica): seed labeling template uploaded; waiting on Velosite samples to finalize mapping.
- Calendar: Friday checkpoint set for 10/30 (we'll keep this cadence going weekly).

Outstanding items we need from Velosite to keep the Wed-Fri cadence:
1) Caroline — seed labels (150) or point person by EOD today (11/01). If it's tight, share even 50 and we'll iterate.
2) Samir — confirm that SecOps ticket has the IP allow-list applied; if not, we need the ticket ID so we can follow up.

If either item slips, we'll pivot: run a synthetic replay to validate latency and end-to-end routing so you still get meaningful perf data while labels arrive.

Short ask: reply-all with the single point of contact for labeling and the SecOps ticket ID so Monica and I can track.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership here.
Ben
